'''Fishing spots''' can be found at the [[Piscatoris Fishing Colony]] during and after the [[Swan Song]] quest. These spots are the only place you can fish [[raw monkfish]], requiring a [[small net]]. Tuna and swordfish can also be caught from these fishing spots with a [[harpoon]].
